channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Pageree
item.description: Build landing pages by chatting with ChatGPT or Claude — no code needed to ship a live page.

item.title: Flowmaps: The Logic Layer for Agents and Developers
item.description: Maps every flow in your codebase into plain-language steps that stay in sync with the code, so developers and AI agents work from the same understanding of the system.

item.title: AI Face Shape Detection and Custom Beard Design
item.description: Upload a selfie and let AI detect your face shape locally in the browser, then generate the beard style that fits it best — the shape test and style match are free.

item.title: Napizo: Free Online Toolbox
item.description: 13 free tools for images, PDFs, AI and text — no sign-up, everything runs right in your browser.

item.title: GIFDB
item.description: Search a huge library of animated GIFs to download and share — handy for finding reaction GIFs and memes.

item.title: Kuwait Indemnity Calculator
item.description: Calculate end-of-service indemnity under Kuwait labor law Articles 51–53 from your tenure and salary.

item.title: Curio: A Design Style Library for AI
item.description: Pick a design style, hand its DESIGN.md to your AI agent, and your site, deck or report gets dressed in seconds.

item.title: Folio: Notes That Live in Your Google Drive, Editable by Your AI
item.description: A free notes app that saves every note as a text file in your own Google Drive, and lets ChatGPT, Claude or Codex read and edit your notes on request.

item.title: SoundEtch: open source podcast/media editor for the browser
item.description: An open source podcast and media editor that runs entirely in the browser — open it and start cutting, no install needed.

item.title: ImgAI
item.description: Generate images and videos in one browser workspace — text-to-image, photo editing, product shots, virtual try-on and viral video templates, across models from OpenAI, Google, FLUX and more.

item.title: DearlyTune
item.description: Turn a name and a few memories into a personalized AI song in about two minutes, with a free 45-second preview before you unlock the full track.

item.title: LALAL.AI
item.description: Split vocals and instruments out of any song with AI, right in the browser — no software to install.

item.title: Fairwind
item.description: List your activities and honors, have the teacher or coach who was there confirm each one, and share a single link on your college application so every entry is vouched for.

item.title: Show HN: Liora Tools – 100% client-side browser utilities in 6 languages
item.description: A full set of handy utilities that run entirely in your browser — your data never leaves your machine — in 6 languages, ready the moment you open it.

item.title: AI Image to Image by PictCraft
item.description: Upload a photo and describe the change in one sentence — the AI redraws only that part while keeping the person, composition and lighting intact.

item.title: iLoveSong: AI Song Generator
item.description: Type a few lyrics, pick a style, and generate a full song online — then turn it into rap or singer performance videos.

item.title: Ploid
item.description: A living index of over two billion people, built as a data layer for AI agents to search, research, and enrich — describe who you are looking for and get an evidence-backed list back.

item.title: Onset
item.description: Connect your YouTube channel and get a review 48 hours after every upload, comparing click-through and retention against your own average, then draft your next title, thumbnail, and video brief from what worked.

item.title: Depost AI
item.description: An AI agent that learns your brand voice, past posts, and knowledge base, then drafts, designs, schedules, and publishes LinkedIn content in your style — the more you use it, the more it sounds like you.

item.title: CrewWorks AI
item.description: Clock in from phone or PC, track work hours, and handle corrections and approvals — attendance and groupware for teams in one place.
